source.captured_from: Existing English poe.ninja character-page screenshot taken 2026-11-19 while transcribing RUOA_CETACEA gear. Numbers below were read from the visible Stats panel crop (see stats-column.png). Do not invent or round differently.
source.zh_labels_note: Traditional Chinese labels for this panel were not captured from the zh-tw ninja page. Do not invent translations. Use existing repo i18n or official PoE2/poe.ninja zh-tw labels if you can verify them; otherwise keep the English label and leave a short code comment listing which labels still need a verified zh-tw string.
source.omitted: ASCENDANCY & KEYSTONES was below the fold and not readable. Do not invent ascendancy or keystone data. A '127 / 4 / 8' control is visible at the bottom of the ninja stats card; copy it only if you can identify what it is from the screenshot, otherwise omit it.

damage_reduction.note: Match colors from stats-column.png; the first value is muted, the later 1% values are highlighted (red/yellow). Do not invent the damage types if the screenshot does not label them; ninja shows four values in one row.
